name: core-vlm-multidomain-binary-pilot
task: classify a cropped core photo as sand-dominated or fine-grained in Russian
sources: USGS Data Series 985 Barnegat Bay core photos and logs
Figshare UKCS Q204/Q205 depth-registered core images and original lithology labels

external_r41_original_intervals.failure_mode: Adapter predicted fine-grained for all 19 source intervals, 16 of which start with sandstone.

evaluation.decision: Do not connect this adapter to the geologist-facing app. The primary ancient-core transfer target R-41 failed at 3/19 despite gains on modern coastal cores.

limitations: Automatically cropped and mapped public-source labels have not been confirmed by a geologist.
R-41 is a single ancient well and its label distribution is strongly imbalanced; this failure is a diagnostic, not a full population estimate.
Cat Island labels and crop-to-depth alignment are provisional.
A binary material class is not a geological description, sedimentary facies, depositional environment or report.
Combining domains in one LoRA adapter did not remove a domain-specific failure; further repeated training on these same labels is not a substitute for reviewed ancient-core examples.
